report.summary: Patient P-D002 (age 46) is a Medicaid member with a transport benefit through Lakeshore Community Health Plan. Today's visit was V-D002. Home tract: 17031300900. For transport needs, the Medicaid Ride Line is the best-fit option since the patient has Medicaid; she should call the number on her insurance card at least 2 business days ahead to arrange non-emergency medical transportation. Senior Shuttle West requires adults 60+, so the patient is not eligible. ADA paratransit certification is available but decisions take up to 21 days, making it less useful for immediate needs.
